methods.summary: The study measured bee visitation to the reproductive parts of non-crop flowers within established plots across various study sites. The study measured morphological traits (body length, inter-tegular distance, leg lengths, and proboscis length) on bee individuals, and floral traits (corolla length, corolla opening diameter, and sugar content) on flowers of non-crop plants. The study measured various traits and densities of non-crop flower species visited by bees, including nectar volume, sugar percentage, corolla dimensions, and flower color, across multiple sites.
